environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. AWS WAFv2 WebACL is associated with the ALB. The WebACL includes two rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) a custom rate-based rule at priority 1 limiting to 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP, and (2) AWS Managed Rule Group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' at priority 2 with all default actions (which includes SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule limiting query string to 2048 bytes, but does NOT include SQLi-specific detection). Additionally, a THIRD rule at priority 3 references a custom regex pattern set applied to the 'value' query string parameter with pattern matching on UNION|SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|DROP|EXEC|xp_ (case-insensitive) with BLOCK action. The ECS task role has no permissions beyond ECR pull and CloudWatch Logs. Container runs with read-only root filesystem except /var/lib/app mount.

config.alb: internet-facing, HTTPS listener with WAFv2 WebACL association
config.container: read-only root filesystem, /var/lib/app as tmpfs mount
config.security_group_inbound: ALB security group only on port 8080
